title: Percentage-of-amount fee clamped down to maxCap: 1.2345% of 1,200,000.00 = 14,814.00, maxCap 5,000.00 -> fee 5,000.00 MNT.
_note: The maxCap branch of charges.MinimumAndMaximumCap (nexus/internal/apps/charges/money.go:90-92, the lower-to-maxCap arm), which no pre-existing vector reached because all 12 committed charges vectors omit min_cap_minor/max_cap_minor. A PERCENT_OF_AMOUNT (calculation_type 2, time_type 1 DISBURSEMENT) charge on the loan principal 1,200,000.00 at 1.2345%. The exact product 1,200,000.00 x 1.2345% = 14,814.00 has no fraction (1481400 minor units) and is ABOVE maxCap 5,000.00, so the oracle lowers it to the cap: totalFeeChargesCharged = 5000.00, feeChargesDue = 5000.00 on the disbursement row of the committed raw capture. The vector transcribes the fee AFTER the clamp.

provenance.note: TRANSCRIBED, never computed, from the committed T51 capture T51-TR-10-c2-maxcap. No oracle contact was made by this promotion; every figure is read off the committed raw JSON. fee_minor 500000 is the exact major->minor scaling of the observed totalFeeChargesCharged 5000.00 (feeChargesDue 5000.000000); base_amount_minor 120000000 is the exact scaling of totalPrincipalDisbursed 1,200,000.00; percentage 1234500 is 1.2345% in micro-per-cent (m_charge stores whole per cent as DECIMAL(19,6): 1.234500); max_cap_minor 500000 is the exact scaling of the charge definition's maxCap 5000. The un-clamped product 1481400 is NOT an observed fee and is recorded only as the arithmetical witness that 5000.00 is the LOWERED value, not the product.
